one_line: Issue tracking and agile project management by Atlassian.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code grants (3LO) for apps; basic auth with an API token for scripts/ad-hoc calls; Forge/Connect apps use scopes and JWT. Text confirms all auth paths.
self_serve_notes: Free plan for small teams (up to 10 users), then paid Standard/Premium. API tokens are self-service from the user profile.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: REST API v3 with hundreds of resources: issues, projects, workflows, fields, users, JQL search, dashboards, permissions, audits, webhooks.
api_surface.webhook_note: Dedicated webhooks resource for issue/project/workflow events.

existing_mcp.note: Community Jira MCP servers exist; official Atlassian MCP not confirmed.

evidence.note: Fetched text is the Jira Cloud REST API v3 reference confirming auth modes, very broad resource list, pagination, and webhooks.

agent_notes: API token + site URL is the fastest path for a solo dev; OAuth for multi-user apps.
